# Site: mrjuaumbr.github.io

## About
This is the personal website and project hub for João Pedro (MrJuaumBR), a young developer from Brazil.

## Developer Information
- **Name**: João Pedro
- **Location**: Brazil
- **Born**: May 9, 2008
- **Started Coding**: Age 10
- **Skills**: Python (Intermediate), Small Basic (Advanced), JavaScript (Basic), Luau/Lua (Basic), Blender (Beginner), Aseprite (Intermediate)
- **Goals**: Pursue Computer Science/Data Science in college, master Python, and create a notable 2D Python game.

## Key Projects
- **[LunaEngine](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine)**: A modern 2D game framework for Python, utilizing OpenGL and OpenAL for high performance. (Actively developed)
- **[MaxPyGame](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/maxpygame)**: A retired PyGame plugin designed to simplify game development with pre-built UI elements.
- **[PixelDungeon 2](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/PixelDungeon2)**: An RPG game built with Python and PyGame.
- **[Abyssal Eclipse](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/AbyssalEclipse)**: A "Vampire Survivors-like" game developed in PyGame.
- **[JPyDB](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/JPyDB)**: A custom database system written in Python.
- **[Wireless Keyboard](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/WirelessKeyboard)**: A tool to transform a smartphone into a wireless macro pad.
